places.name: The New York Times Building
places.connection: Bill Cunningham worked for The New York Times, and the building is featured in the documentary.

places.name: Carnegie Hall
places.connection: Bill Cunningham lived in a studio apartment above Carnegie Hall, and this location is highlighted in the film.

places.name: Fifth Avenue
places.connection: Bill Cunningham was known for photographing fashion on the streets of Fifth Avenue.

places.name: Central Park
places.connection: Central Park is featured in the documentary as a backdrop for Bill Cunningham's street photography.

places.name: Bergdorf Goodman
places.connection: Bergdorf Goodman is one of the iconic fashion locations featured in the documentary.

places.name: Bill Cunningham's Apartment at Carnegie Hall
places.connection: Primary filming location for the 1994 interview with Bill Cunningham, which forms the narrative backbone of the documentary. Also, his longtime residence.

places.name: The New York Times Building
places.connection: Bill Cunningham's workplace for decades, where his iconic 'On the Street' and 'Evening Hours' columns were published. Archival footage likely shows him working or entering/exiting.

places.name: Bryant Park
places.connection: A primary historical venue for New York Fashion Week (pre-2010), where Bill Cunningham extensively photographed street style and runway shows. Featured in archival footage.

places.name: Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts
places.connection: A significant New York Fashion Week venue from 2010-2015, where Bill Cunningham continued his street and runway photography. Featured in archival footage.

places.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (Met Gala Entrance)
places.connection: A key location for Bill Cunningham's 'Evening Hours' column, where he photographed high society and celebrity fashion at galas, most notably the annual Met Gala.

places.name: Intersection of 57th Street and 5th Avenue
places.connection: A quintessential New York fashion intersection and a frequent spot for Bill Cunningham to photograph street style and everyday fashion.

places.name: Central Park (Bethesda Terrace)
places.connection: One of many areas in Central Park where Bill Cunningham would capture everyday fashion, special events like the Easter Parade, and candid moments.

places.name: IFC Center
places.connection: Official premiere venue for 'The Times of Bill Cunningham' at the Doc NYC film festival in 2018.

places.name: Bergdorf Goodman
places.connection: An iconic luxury department store on 5th Avenue, a prime location for Bill Cunningham's street photography, capturing the fashion of shoppers and window displays.

places.name: Grand Palais, Paris
places.connection: A historic and prominent venue for haute couture shows during Paris Fashion Week, which Bill Cunningham frequently covered, showcasing his international reach.

places.name: New York Public Library (Stephen A. Schwarzman Building)
places.connection: A cultural landmark in New York City, reflecting Bill Cunningham's intellectual curiosity and connection to the city's institutions. A pilgrimage site for fans.

places.name: The High Line (Gansevoort Market Entrance)
places.connection: A modern urban park that became a popular spot for street style photography in Bill Cunningham's later years, showcasing the evolving fashion landscape of NYC.
